utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I've got an old toaster to bring, and I heard Tess is bringing hers too. Oren'll be there early, so that's good.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my soldering iron and multimeter if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That'd be a big help, Gus. We'll definitely put those to use.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I'm excited about the repair drive! I'm bringing my tool kits and I even have a soldering iron if anyone needs it. By the way, I'm fixing Gus's blender next week.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Tess! I'll make a note that you have the soldering iron. Opal shared the map with me, so we'll coordinate on who brings what.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I'll check the map later. Just let me know what else you need me to bring!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oren said he'll be there early with his toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I've got my toolkit and some spare parts ready to go too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Rosa's got the whole day set aside, so I'll try to make it when I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Two toasters? Are we sure we have enough space and power for both?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We can run one at a time if needed! And I think we have enough counter space in the garage.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: And what about the power draw? Is the garage circuit strong enough for that, or do we have backup plans from Dane?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I'm late. I've got a wrench in the trunk if we need it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did Ira get the parts ordered?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I'm not sure about Ira, but Opal has a map of the spots we need to hit.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, so Cleo has the toolkit and spare parts, Tess is bringing her old toaster, and Sam has tools. Are we all set for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right! I'll be there early with my toolbox. Did I mention Nell's bringing her old toaster too?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, good, another toaster! That'll give us more options to practice on. Should we make a list of what everyone's bringing so we don't have duplicates?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Just making sure, we're still on for 2 PM at Sam's garage, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, Saturday at 2 at Sam's. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, see you then.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Ira, are Jules and you ready to start the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think we're set. Oren's bringing a toolbox, Rosa has tool kits, and Opal has a map of the spots.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, I thought it was just you and Jules. Where did Oren, Rosa, and Opal come from?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've finished mapping out all the spots that need repairs for Saturday. I'll send the map to you and Jules.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, send it over. Any tricky spots I should know about?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The bike path near the old oak has a tricky pothole that needs patching; I marked it on the map.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Quinn, glad you're bringing the blender. Oren will be here early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I've got the blender ready. Excited to see everyone chip in!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's good to hear. I heard Tess and Nell are both bringing old toasters, so we'll have plenty to work on.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, Jules and Ira said they'll come to the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great news! The more hands, the better. I'll make sure we have enough tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, so it'll be Jules and Ira for sure.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, is the drive today? I thought it was next week...

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: No, it's today. Saturday, remember?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right. I think Cleo mentioned having some spare parts ready. Good.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got a basic toolkit and some spare parts ready for the repair drive. Do you have anything you'd like to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard Tess and Nell are both bringing old toasters. Maybe we can pair them up for a fix.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I knew Tess was bringing one, but Nell too? That's great, we can try to fix both.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, the repair drive is this Saturday! Do you have any tools or skills you can bring?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday works for me, I'll see what I can scrounge up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I'm mapping out what everyone's bringing. Got any specialty tools or particular skills you're known for?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there, though I might have to step out early. Oren's bringing his toolbox, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I'm bringing the tool kits! And Tess is coordinating who has what, so I'm sure Oren's toolbox is on the list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I'll help as much as I can between my other obligations.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Quinn, just checking in—Sam's bringing tools, Cleo has a toolkit and spare parts, and Tess is bringing her old toaster. Anything else we need?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I'm bringing a blender, so that should help with any small appliance fixes. Anything else missing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, the blender should be useful. I think we might need some extension cords or a power strip—any chance you have one of those?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, are you sure we'll have enough space for all those toasters?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Ira and Jules are coming to help, so we should have enough hands to manage the space.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's good to know, but I'm still worried about fitting everyone and everything in the driveway.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'll be bringing my old toaster to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's good to hear. Oren's bringing a toolbox and Rosa's got tool kits too, so we'll be set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I'm glad Oren will be there early to help set up. I'll see you at the drive!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I almost forgot—Nell's bringing that old toaster of hers, right? I'll be there early with my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I bet Nell's toaster is a classic! I've got my soldering iron ready for Gus's blender—should be a fun afternoon, see you there!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the blender! I'll be there early, don't you worry.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Leo, I'm glad the repair drive is this Saturday. Rosa's cleared her whole day, and Oren plans to come early.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Bring extension cords—we'll need them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'll grab mine; see you Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Ira and Jules are coming to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, the more the merrier. I'll share my repair map with them when they get here.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, so it's all set—Ira and Jules will be here for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I'm getting the tools ready with Eli for the repair drive—everything's shaping up nicely.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, the repair drive is still on Saturday, right? I just want to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, Saturday as planned! Oren and Rosa are also coming early, so we'll have plenty of hands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let's stick to the plan, Gus. I'll be at Sam's garage at 2 PM to sort out the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli. I'll bring my toolbox and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, we'll be all set then.
